eyebrow: SQL Dialects: T-SQL, PL/SQL, MySQL & Beyond · Chapter Nine
subtitle: Lesson 56 · Cloud Warehouse SQL Dialects

caption: Backtick-quoted project.dataset.table -- BigQuery's visual signature.

code:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  tags,                      -- ARRAY<STRING>
  address.city, address.zip  -- STRUCT, dot notation
FROM `my-project.sales_dataset.customers`;
caption: A single column can hold a repeated value or a nested record directly.

eyebrow: Redshift: closest to PostgreSQL in this course
code:
-- Redshift -- reads almost exactly like PostgreSQL
SELECT customer_id, order_date, total_due
FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01'
LIMIT 10;
caption: Built on an older Postgres fork -- the least new learning of any warehouse here.

code:
-- Real Redshift DDL -- administration territory
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INT, customer_id INT)
DISTKEY(customer_id)
SORTKEY(order_date);
caption: Physical-design concern, not a language-comparison one -- not covered here.
